info.name: Returns all appealable issues for a specific Veteran.

params.name: decisionReviewType
params.description: Scoping of appeal type for associated issues

params.name: benefitType
params.description: Required if decision review type is Higher-Level Reviews or Supplemental Claims

params.name: receiptDate
params.description: (yyyy-mm-dd) In order to determine appealability of issues, the receipt date of a hypothetical Decision Review must be specified.

params.name: icn
params.description: Veteran's Master Person Index (MPI) Integration Control Number (ICN)

auth.accessTokenUrl: To get production access, you must either work for VA or have specific VA agreements in place. If you have questions, [contact us](https://developer.va.gov/support/contact-us).

items.docs: Returns all issues associated with a Veteran that have been decided as of the `receiptDate`. Not all issues returned are guaranteed to be eligible for appeal.
